title: Installment Schedule for Trade-In Chargeback Shortfalls
content:
Three installments, two, or one: a **Trade-In Agreements** shortfall left by a title-delay chargeback is spread evenly over a number of installments set by the size of the shortfall.

**The shortfall** is figured from the agreement's ledger as the value-credited and covering entries less the deduction, lien payoff and distributed-equity entries, taken as a positive amount and never less than none.

| Shortfall | Installments |
|---|---|
| $1200.00 or more | 3 |
| At least $600.00 but below $1200.00 | 2 |
| Below $600.00 | 1 |

## Boundaries

| Shortfall | Installments |
|---|---|
| $599.99 | 1 |
| $600.00 | 2 |
| $1199.99 | 2 |
| $1200.00 | 3 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A shortfall of $1500.00 is spread over 3 installments of $500.00 each; a shortfall of $900.00 over 2 installments of $450.00; a shortfall of $350.00 is paid in one.
